items.text: The AI tools for career growth India that actually help are not one magic app.
They are five practical categories: resume and interview prep, faster learning, research and market tracking, writing and communication polish, and building proof of work faster.
Used deliberately, these tools shorten the time it takes to build a genuine high-income skill portfolio, the actual driver of earlier financial freedom, not the tools themselves.
